entries.title: Implement target-repo artifact categories, local Git exclusion, and persistent user choices
entries.summary: Durable artifacts now use the approved target-repository layout with run-keyed categories.；决策：Use exact local Git exclude patterns managed in .git/info/exclude.
entries.body:
## 决策
- Use exact local Git exclude patterns managed in .git/info/exclude.
- Treat context as a current snapshot and user choices as an append-only ledger.
- Migrate only the current legacy run and never overwrite an existing destination.

## 约束
- Keep context.md, learnings.md, learnings.md.lock, and user_choices.md flat under target_repo/runs.
- Store plans, tasks, reviews, and events in category paths keyed by run ID.
- Do not hide project-owned files elsewhere under target_repo/runs from Git.

entries.title: Fix first-run artifact initialization for every applicable artifact
entries.summary: First-run target repositories now initialize every artifact whose empty form is valid before agent dispatch.；决策：Eagerly create context, learnings, learnings lock, user choices, and run events after legacy migration.
entries.body:
## 决策
- Eagerly create context, learnings, learnings lock, user choices, and run events after legacy migration.

## 约束
- Initialization must never overwrite migrated or existing cross-run artifact content.
- Plans, tasks, and reviews must not exist until their owning stage produces valid content.
